attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The owners are offering compensation for the loss of goods.","severity":"major","reason":"the reward detail comes from an earlier bulletin, not the briefing's facts, and it is changed from a reward for return to compensation"},{"span":"The Rustback Raiders were heard to have targeted a caravan on the old highway.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as if newly heard"},{"span":"Six settlements are currently involved in this tiresome exchange.","severity":"major","reason":"wrong: six is the Sun Throne's settlement count, while the tribute demands went to the Cobalt Free Towns (seven settlements)"},{"span":"It hardly changes the balance of power, but it does give the Empire something to grumble about.","severity":"minor","reason":"implied consequence not in the briefing"},{"span":"It seems the Empire has a very reliable, if tedious, revenue stream to rely on.","severity":"minor","reason":"contradicts the new refusal and implies tribute is being paid; hedged but unsupported"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The dry voice is serviceable, but the second item repeats old news and distorts it (compensation instead of reward), and the third misstates the six settlements as involved in the tribute exchange. The new item is correct but gets padded with old material instead of a proper quiet-week treatment."}
